title: 流程条件里 addDays(today(), N) 和日期字段比较：保存和发布都通过，但每次运行都求值失败（接 #37848）
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibyUSf2nKJWW6qBemSU

Filing gate: ① (b) side finding from the #37848 card thread, measured on origin/main 5b8ca361 (the readings close #37848, comment 7233296667). Source: fleet.
Grading: area:build · Bug · p2 · reach: every flow, validation or automation condition that compares `addDays(today(), N)` (or the same with a bare comparison in front) with a date field · evidence: measured at all three doors plus the runtime.
Dedupe: "addDays", "addDays today date field condition", "no such overload Timestamp dyn string", "date field CEL runtime" → 0 open.

## 维护者速读

- 问题：流程条件写成「30 天后的日期大于到期日」这类，用 addDays(today(), 30) 和日期字段比，保存、校验、发布都通过，流程也会变成启用状态，但每次运行条件都求值失败，自动化一次都不会按预期执行。
- 原因：日期字段在运行时是「年-月-日」文字。拿它和 today() 直接比时，运行时会自动转换；换成 addDays(today(), N) 就转换不了。
- 修法：让运行时对 addDays 的结果也做同样的转换，跟 today() 一致。做不到的话，至少在保存时就拒掉，并提示用 date(record.due_date)。
- 要你做的：无。

## Measured (origin/main 5b8ca361, full table `/mnt/project-files/card-37848/pre-claim-report-5b8ca361.md`)

- `addDays(today(), 30) > record.due_date`, and the same with `due_date > "2026-01-01" && ` in front: `os validate` reads `valid: true`. Publish succeeds and the flow becomes active. Every flow `execute` returns `success: false` with "condition failed to evaluate as CEL: no such overload: google.protobuf.Timestamp > dyn<string>".
- Controls: `record.due_date < today()` (also `now()`, `daysFromNow()`) evaluates. `addDays(today(), 30) > date(record.due_date)` evaluates.
- The class is #36377's: a spelling that no save door refuses, and that then fails at run time.

## Ask

1. A condition that compares `addDays(today(), N)` with a date field evaluates at run time the way the `today()` comparison already does. If that coercion cannot be extended, the save doors (`os validate`, publish, `registerFlow`) refuse the spelling and name `date(record.<field>)` as the fix.
2. Pins at all three doors and in the flow runtime, with the `today()` and `date()` controls, and an ablation.

## Acceptance

- The spelling either runs correctly or is refused at save. It is never accepted at save and then failed at every run.
- Related: #36377, #37848, PR #37840.
